verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog states that the mobile app lets you review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent. Diffs, its review experience, is available on iOS and Android, and Linear Agent writes code via Claude Code and Codex. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile review flow, and in-depth documentation of how line comments drive the agent's next iteration (only a single changelog sentence).

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate

citations.quote: Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.
Diffs, Linear’s fast and focused review experience, is now available for iOS and Android.
Linear Agent can now write code using Claude Code and Codex.
